# Face fixture image sources

All images are public-domain historical portrait photographs (pre-1900, US federal
public domain / no known copyright restrictions), sourced from Wikimedia Commons and
downsized for the test suite. Used purely as detectable-face test data, not for any
identity-recognition claim about the subjects.

- `person_a_1.jpg` — Abraham Lincoln, matte collodion print.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abraham_Lincoln_O-77_matte_collodion_print.jpg
- `person_a_2.jpg` — `person_a_1.jpg`, horizontally mirrored, standing in as a second
  distinct capture of the "same person" for same-identity match tests.
- `person_b_1.jpg` — Frederick Douglass, c. 1879.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frederick_Douglass_(circa_1879).jpg
- `classroom_two_faces.jpg` — `person_a_1.jpg` and `person_b_1.jpg` composited
  side-by-side, standing in for a multi-face classroom photo.
